name: Veg Do Pyaza

ingredients.name: onions, half finely chopped and half in petals

steps: Blanch cauliflower and peas in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain. Keep the onion petals separate from the finely chopped onion.
Heat 15 ml oil in a pan and stir-fry onion petals and capsicum for 3 minutes until lightly browned but still crisp; remove to a plate.
Heat remaining oil, sizzle cumin and cook chopped onion for 7–8 minutes until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, coriander and chili; fry 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, salt and water. Simmer 8 minutes until the gravy thickens, then add cauliflower and peas and cook 5 minutes.
Fold in the reserved onion petals and capsicum with garam masala. Cook just 1 minute and serve, leaving the second batch of onions clearly visible.
tips: Do pyaza gets its character from onions cooked twice to two textures; do not simmer the onion petals until soft.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
